test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the appropriate synonym for the underlined word.**

She goes to her room and **__locks__** herself in.
solution: The correct answer is **"shuts."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Locks" **means to put somebody/something in a safe place and lock it. ((किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु) को सुरक्षित स्‍थान पर ताला लगाकर रखना) • **Example**: ***Lock**__ your passport in a safe place.* • **"Shuts"** is a synonym for **"locks."** • The verb **"shuts"** means to make something close; to become closed. ((किसी को) बंद करना; (किसी का) बंद होना) __ • **Example**:* I can’t **shut**__ my suitcase.* • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2, "hurts"**, means to cause somebody/yourself physical pain or injury. (अपने या किसी को तकलीफ़ देना या चोट पहुँचाना) • **Option 3, "sinks"**, means to go down or make something go down under the surface of liquid or a soft substance. (डूबना या (किसी वस्‍तु को) डुबोना (तरल या कोमल पदार्थ में)) • **Option 4, "taunts"**, means to try to make somebody angry or upset by saying unpleasant or cruel things. (किसी को ताना मारना, किसी पर फबती कसना) 1a9:Tc52, The correct answer is **"arousal."**
